reviews_captured_by_me.text:
After emerging from a failed  small bathroom project execution by a different “contractor”, a friend of ours referred Frias construction to help us fix what was a disaster of a project. We were on high alert due to the past experience but Javier with Frias construction quickly showed that we had found the right group to fix this failed project. Javier kept up to date throughout every step, consulted us  and made great recommendations for this project,
We will definitely be working with Frias construction for many projects to come.
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 5 months ago
Thank you so much for trusting Frias Remodeling to a step in and help to fix your project. We know how frustrating that situation can be, we are really glad could turn it around for you.

It was a pleasure working with you, we truly appreciate your trust and accommodation. Looking forward to working together again and future projects.
